pre_registered.question: does a laptop-width walk find what 414 hides (Paul found one on 2026-09-06)?
pre_registered.evidence: journey-view.py hardcodes viewport 414x848 with no flag, so zero laptop-width walks exist and none can be produced by the loop's own tooling. The question was addressed to an instrument that cannot answer it.
pre_registered.ruling: paul-ruled 2026-09-07: retire the pre-registration; do NOT build the flag; DECLARE the gap instead. release-gate.py now prints a coverage line reading the viewport constant out of journey-view.py, so every gate states that a pass says nothing about laptop width. Counted, never graded — the line refuses nothing.
pre_registered.why_not_build: Mom is the make-or-break user and she is on a phone at A+; 414 is the design centre and a laptop has no confirmed user but Paul. ⛔ But 'Paul will catch it' is not coverage — a channel he already covers is a LEADING INDICATOR, not a safety net — so the gap is stated every lap rather than left silently absent. The flag stays available if it ever earns itself.
